name: SSR-180,711
summary: SSR180711 is a drug that acts as a potent and selective partial agonist for the α7 subtype of neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. In animal studies, it shows nootropic effects and may be useful in the treatment of schizophrenia.

pharmacology.text: SSR180711 is a drug that acts as a potent and selective partial agonist for the α7 subtype of neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

uses.text: In animal studies, it shows nootropic effects and may be useful in the treatment of schizophrenia.

fact.en: The SSR prefix in its name marks it as a research compound from the French drug company Sanofi-Synthélabo. It targets the α7 nicotinic receptor, one of the most common nicotinic receptors in the brain.
fact.zh: 名稱中的SSR字首代表它是法國藥廠賽諾菲聖德拉堡的研究化合物。它作用於α7菸鹼型受體，這是腦中最常見的菸鹼型受體之一。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的SSR前缀代表它是法国药厂赛诺菲圣德拉堡的研究化合物。它作用于α7烟碱型受体，这是脑中最常见的烟碱型受体之一。
